For more details we are using Redis api of Yugabyte, this is what we see in the client repeadtedly :-  
Caused by: com.lambdaworks.redis.RedisCommandExecutionException: Some errors occurred
 at com.lambdaworks.redis.protocol.AsyncCommand.completeResult(AsyncCommand.java:119)
 at com.lambdaworks.redis.protocol.AsyncCommand.complete(AsyncCommand.java:110)
 at com.lambdaworks.redis.protocol.CommandHandler.complete(CommandHandler.java:336)

@amit2103 Thank you for reporting this issue! Would you mind uploading the full set of master / tablet server logs for this system, as well as tell us more about the deployment? (Local cluster / distributed cluster, machine configuration, number of disks, etc.) Also would you mind checking if there is sufficient disk space on the cluster nodes?
Putting the stack trace in an easier-to-view format: https://gist.githubusercontent.com/mbautin/b6524763c852fdbb0a8192ed947661fb/raw
@mbautin  This is a 3 node cluster. Its m4.large each of them
Some files are so large cant upload them

@amit2103 Even if tablet server logs are too long, it would be extremely useful for us to have them for diagnosing this issue. Perhaps you could limit it to the last 10MB or so by using `tail -c 10000000 file_name >file_name_for_upload`. Also would you mind double-checking the free disk space on the cluster nodes? Thank you!

The server had 8GB of hard disk left.
we have upgraded it to 40GB now (empty space).

@amit2103 can we do a video call so we can do some live debugging on your cluster? You can email me at (email hidden) with some time slots that would work for you. I'm seeing a couple of different issues in the logs, neither of which we've seen in our own cluster testing, and I would like to understand your setup and workload a little better.
@mbautin I sent you an email regarding this, please double check it, thanks
